name: v07-holdout-alpha
description: SS11.12 - the single holdout validation of the alpha-mode changes. Run once, after every tune decision was settled. The incumbent is the alpha layout as shipped at the start of SS11, so the delta is what stabilizing v0.7 moves alpha mode by. The tier-0 candidate is A28@3 L22@4 C3@3 and the compact-tier candidate A16@3 L12@4 C1@3; both were chosen on tune by protecting the mostly-opaque subgroup rather than by taking the deltaE00-optimal corner.
